of Minimum Amount Tk. 7.00 (Seven) Lac single Contract within last 05 ( Five) years Under in Govt./ Semi Govt./

Lac only.

(e) The Tenderer must have Income Tax clearance Certificate (2024-2025).
(f) The Tenderer must have VAT/BIN Registration Certificate.
(g) The Tenderer must have valid Trade License (2025-2026)
